title: Text chat ads stop getting in the answer’s way
summary:
Text chat ads got less intrusive, DeepSeek responses got a simpler path, and two community bots became easier to find.

Text chat ads moved from local affiliate matching to nex.ad, with Ko-fi as a fallback. Ads are appended rather than replacing the assistant’s answer, and JSON-mode responses skip them entirely.

The DeepSeek-v3 response formatter was disabled, so it no longer moves reasoning content into the answer or wraps it in <think> tags. Streaming responses also bypass the SSE formatter when none is configured.

ImageEditer joined the creative apps list with its Telegram image-generation and editing features. Gacha’s listing now points directly to its Discord invite and describes its chat, image, voice, and search features.
